method: To make the pani: Grind mint leaves, coriander leaves, green chilies, and ginger into a fine paste. Mix this with 1 liter of water.
Add tamarind extract, jaggery, black salt, and cumin powder to the water. Mix well and strain it.
To make the stuffing: In a bowl, mix the mashed potatoes, boiled chickpeas, chaat masala, salt, and chopped coriander leaves.
To serve: Poke a hole in the center of a puri, fill it with a little stuffing, and dip it into the spiced water (pani).
